why.zh: 派英雄進行時間最短的冒險來獲得一匹馬。然後開始打野！
why.en: Send hero on the shortest adventure to get a horse. Then smash animals!

why.zh: 啟用 25% 資源加成
why.en: Activate 25% resc production bonus.

why.zh:
依可以打的綠洲數量，決定戰鬥力要點幾點。
0 個綠洲：最多 2 點
1～5 個綠洲：8 到 12 點
6 個以上綠洲：12 點以上
打野過程中使用任務獎勵的經驗值升級英雄，回復英雄的生命值，建議用模擬器看看打野會損失多少血量。將剩餘的技能點點到資源上。
英雄幾乎不可能 24 小時打野，因此將一些點數投入到資源上能夠取得更多資源收入。
why.en:
Put points in strength according to the amount of oasis you can raid.
0 oasis: max 2 points 
1-5 oasis: 8/12 points
6+ oasis: 12(+) points
Use the rewards to level up your hero to full health after smashing animals. Put the rest in resc production. 
The chances of using your hero for 24h are very small and putting some extra points in resc production helps generating more resc when your hero can't clear any oasis anymore.

steps.target: 每種資源田各一塊升到 2

why.zh: 繼續打野，直到你需要走 1 小時以上，並且你確定能清掉那裡的動物。之後考慮去冒險 2（獎勵是資源）。冒險大約能獲得 2300 資源。
why.en: Raid Oasis until you need to walk 1h+, of which you are sure you will clear the animals, after that considor to do adventure 2 (resc bounty). Adventure gives about 2300 resc.

why.zh: 繼續打野，直到路程要 2 小時以上，此時你應考慮使用英雄的智慧之書洗點，將幾乎所有點數投入到資源產量中（適當保留一些戰鬥力用於冒險）。智慧之書可在冒險 6 中獲取，通常在開始遊戲後的 24 小時內就能得到。
why.en: Continue to raid oasis until 2h+ walkig time, then you should consider to put almost all points in resc production with the book of wisdom for hero. Book is obtained in adventure 6, usually comes within 24h after starting.

steps.target: 每種資源田各一塊升到 4

why.zh:
打野要做多少兵很難說。Excel 裡有一些簡單的試算，可以幫你判斷划不划算。
建議數量：
- 騎兵 7 到 12 隻
- 步兵 30 到 60 隻
做兵的時機也很重要：綠洲要等動物全部清掉後才會開始產出，所以不建議一開始就做打野兵。最有效率的數量看情況，依附近綠洲的實際手感決定。
why.en:
For farming it will be difficult to determine how many units to make. In the sheet we added some general calculations which can help to determine if you can make it profitable. 
Recommended numbers are: 
- 7 to 12 for Cavalry 
- 30 to 60 for Infantery. 
Timing of making units is also important, oasis only produce after all animals are killed. So to start with farming units right away is not recommended. Most efficient amount of farm units is situational. Base this number on touch and feel results on nearby oasis.

steps.target: 升到 5（只有帝國騎兵需要）

why.zh: 重要提醒：雷法師、帝國騎兵和草原騎兵可以單獨派去沒有動物的綠洲！
why.en: Important reminder: TT, EI & SR can be sent solo to an empty oasis!

why.zh: 目標：12／16 小時內全部升到 4
why.en: Goal: reach all 4 in 12/16h

why.zh: 人口和文明點的獎勵（Excel 裡標橘色的）要看馬廄升到 3 還是 5，請留意，不要太早把它算進來。
why.en: Pop & CP rewards in orange are dependable on stable to 3 or 5. Please be aware of it and don't expect it prematurely.

why.zh: 目標：最多 48 小時開第一場派對
why.en: Goal: party 1 in max 48h

steps.target: Excel 預設 0 隻，依 ROI 自己決定

why.zh:
這裡依 ROI 決定要升哪些資源田，或是多投資打野兵；別忘了你已經在打野，資源收入比較多。也許更該把重點放在文明點產量，因為要在 4 場派對內拓荒，文明點產量本來就得升。5 級資源田的 ROI：
伐木場 67.4 小時
泥坑 67.7 小時
鐵礦場 82.5 小時
農田 76.7 小時
ROI 以英雄 6 級領到的獎勵計算。不建議升鐵礦場，埃及人尤其不要。
why.en:
Check here which fields you want to upgrade based on ROI or invest more in farm units, bare in mind you already farm and have more resc income. Might be better to focus more on CP production, since that needs to be upgraded anyway to make it in 4 parties. Nonetheless ROI for the fields 5 are:
Wood - 67,4h
Clay - 67,7h
Iron - 82,5h
Crop - 76,7h
ROI is calculated with the reward cashed with hero level 6. Iron mines are not recommended to do, especially for Egyptians a no-go.

steps.building: 開新村前先留 3000 資源
steps.building_en: Don't forget about the 3k resc for launching!

sections.title: 選做：便宜的文明點建築

intro.zh: 如果你推進得很快，可能會缺文明點，以下是一些建築，可以用比較少的資源換到文明點，同時如果你資源多，也可以選擇升級城鎮廳來縮短派對時間。
intro.en:
If you went like really fast, due to a good spawn or bossing it yourself, you might run into some CP related issues. Speeding up the process before party 1 results in less time where CP gets generated by the CP production. To cope with this below an overview of the cheaper CP per resc buildings. 
Some tips regarding upgrading your town hall are also included. It can be profitable to upgrade your town hall to get the CP from a party faster.

why.zh: 進階：如果資源收入比需要的多，還有空間加快拓荒，可以考慮升級城鎮廳，縮短派對的時間，早點拿到派對的文明點。
why.en: Pro tip: If resc income is more than you need and you have room for speeding up your settling time, check for upping your town hall to shorten the party duration and have CP of a party faster.

why.zh: 重要提醒：已經在排隊的派對，升級城鎮廳不會縮短它的時間。派對排隊中才提高文明點產量的話，增加的部分要等下一場派對開始才算。
why.en: Important reminder: a party in queue will not be shortened in duration when upping TH. When upgrading CP (while having a party in queue) the increase will be given when next party starts.

why.zh: 啟用 25% 資源加成
why.en: Activate 25% bonus for Resources

why.zh: 英雄只去第一次冒險
why.en: Send Hero only on first adventure

why.zh:
依可以打的綠洲數量，決定戰鬥力要點幾點。
0 個綠洲：最多 2 點
1～5 個綠洲：8 到 12 點
6 個以上綠洲：12 點以上
打野過程中使用任務獎勵的經驗值升級英雄，回復英雄的生命值，建議用模擬器看看打野會損失多少血量。將剩餘的技能點點到資源上。
英雄幾乎不可能 24 小時打野，因此將一些點數投入到資源上能夠取得更多資源收入。
why.en:
Put points in strength according to the amount of oasis you can raid.
0 oasis: max 2 points 
1-5 oasis: 8/12 points
6+ oasis: 12(+) points
Use the rewards to level up your hero to full health after smashing animals. Put the rest in resc production. 
The chances of using your hero for 24h(+) are very small and putting some extra points in resc production helps generating more income, when your hero can't clear any oasis anymore.

steps.target: 每種資源田各一塊升到 2

why.zh: 持續打綠洲，直到要走 1 小時以上；之後考慮去冒險 2（資源）。冒險大約能拿到 2300 資源。
why.en: Raid Oasis until you need to walk 1h+ then consider to do adventure 2 (resc). Adventure gives about 2300 resc.

why.zh: 繼續打野，直到路程要 2 小時以上，此時你應考慮使用英雄的智慧之書洗點，將幾乎所有點數投入到資源產量中（適當保留一些戰鬥力用於冒險）。智慧之書可在冒險 6 中獲取，通常在開始遊戲後的 24 小時內就能得到。
why.en: Continue to raid oasis until 2h+ walkig time, then you should consider to put almost all points in resc production with the book of wisdom for hero. Book is obtained in adventure 6, usually comes within 24h after starting.

steps.target: 每種資源田各一塊升到 4

why.zh: 目標：最多 2 小時到這一步
why.en: Goal: get here in 2h max

why.zh: 目標：12 小時內所有資源田升到 4。
why.en: Goal: get all fields on 4 in 12h.

why.zh: 建議：農田升到 6 級，因為每塊會多 1 點文明點產量。之後文明點的花費會越來越高，可以把一塊農田看成 1250 資源的文明點投資，這樣農田本身只算 2000，ROI 大約 66 小時，加上文明點換算的成本低，很划算。
why.en: ADVICED: Lv6 crop fields are done due to the 1 CP prod it gives. Since CP costs rise later on, consider 1 crop to be a 1250 resc investment in CP. That makes the costs only 2000, ROI for the fields would then be 66 hours, which is reasonable beside the low CP per resc cost of the field itself.

why.zh: 選做：穀物磨坊 1 級也是一個選項，搭配 6 級農田、算進任務獎勵的 ROI 是 63 小時。不過要拆掉一個山洞才有空地。
why.en: OPTIONAL: Grain mill 1 is an option as with lv6 fields it has a ROI of 63h included the task reward. However it will require to demolish a cranny.

why.zh:
接下來是比較難的部分，請注意！
如果你打野打得好，預計不到 48 小時就能開第一場派對，平常每小時產出的文明點會不夠，要靠提高文明點產量補回來。一定要算清楚你需要多少文明點、還差多少，再用下面的表補足。記得你有 3 場派對、至少 48 小時的產出可以補回少掉的文明點。
why.en:
So here comes the tricky part! Pay attention!
If you farmed well and you expect to do party 1 faster than 48h, you've too less CP generated from regular production/ hour. This needs to be compensated and this is done by upgrading your CP production. It is critical to calculate how much CP you need and therewith know how much you lack. Determine how much CP you need to compensate and use the table below to fix it. Remember you have 3 parties and at least 48h of production to compensate the missed CP.

why.zh: 目標：72 小時內開第一場派對
why.en: Goal: get party 1 in 72h

why.zh: 拓荒者的花費依部族不同，請在上方選部族。
why.en: For accurate settler costs select tribe above!

steps.building: 開新村前先留 3000 資源
steps.building_en: Don't forget the 3k resc for launching!
